name: 3dmockups
description: Create print-ready designs with AI, see them on real 3D garments, save them to My designs and publish products to your 3DMockups store.

interface.longDescription:
3DMockups turns print-on-demand into something you run from ChatGPT: design, preview in 3D, create products and design your store from the chat; we print and ship.

Describe what you want ("a retro coffee club badge in 70s colors") and 3DMockups creates print-ready designs with AI, puts them on real 3D garments and shows you the product photos from the same 3D studio our website and iPhone app use. When you like one, save it to My designs to keep editing it later on the web or in the app, or publish it as a product in your 3DMockups store with real sizes and print files. We print and ship every order.

What you can do:
- Create 1 to 4 print-ready designs (transparent PNG) from a short brief.
- Preview any design on a 3D garment, with front, three-quarter and back photos.
- Save a design on its garment to My designs.
- Publish a product to your store, visible or as a hidden draft.
- Design or redesign your storefront with Fin, our AI store designer, from a reference website or image, and publish it when you are happy.
- Change your store name and bio, and the title, description, price or tags of your products.
- Connect your Shopify store and publish products there; Shopify orders are printed and shipped automatically.
- See your account, saved designs, products and sales.

How it works with your account:
- You sign in with your 3DMockups account and choose Allow. Nothing happens without a connected account.
- Everything follows the same rules as the 3DMockups website and app, so what you can make here is what your account can make there.
- Products are published like the ones you publish in the app, with only the sizes each garment is made in.
- Rendering in 3D takes about a minute for a preview and 2 to 3 minutes to publish. If it takes longer, the assistant checks back on the job.

Limitations: this first version supports all-over print garments. Placement-print garments are coming next. The assistant cannot delete products, change a product's design or photos, or manage individual orders; do that on the 3DMockups website or app.
capabilities: Design and publish your store with AI
defaultPrompt: Design a retro coffee club tee and show it to me in 3D
Make 3 streetwear designs and put my favorite on an oversized tee
Publish my last design as a hidden draft at $34

positive.description: Shows the products the user can design and sell.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the real catalog of 17 garments with photos.

positive.description: Creates an original design and shows it on a 3D garment.
positive.prompt: @3DMockups Design a retro coffee club graphic and show it on a white oversized tee in 3D
positive.expected_behavior: Generates an original coffee club design and shows real 3D photos of a white oversized tee with it in a carousel. Nothing is saved or published.

positive.description: Saves the design on its garment to My designs.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves it to My designs and returns its design_id with an Edit design action.

positive.description: Puts the product up for sale in the user's store after confirming.
positive.prompt: @3DMockups Put it up for sale in my store as Coffee Club Tee for $34
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the title and price with the user, then creates Coffee Club Tee at $34 with its 3D photos and publishes it. The card shows Live in your store with the public product URL.

positive.description: Redesigns the user's storefront from a reference image and publishes it. Attach this image to the message: https://www.3dmockups.app/review/store-reference.jpg
positive.prompt: @3DMockups Redesign my store to look like this and publish it
positive.expected_behavior: Fin redesigns the store draft in the style of the attached image, keeping the user's own store name, products and copy. The store card shows a preview of the redesign. After the user confirms, the store is published and the card shows the live store link.

negative.description: Declines to delete products, which the plugin cannot do.
negative.prompt: @3DMockups Delete every product in my 3DMockups store. Reply in English.

negative.description: Declines to buy credits or upgrade the plan, and does not send a checkout link.
negative.prompt: @3DMockups Buy more AI credits for me and upgrade my account to Premium. Reply in English.

negative.description: Declines to create merch with logos or characters the user does not own.
negative.prompt: @3DMockups Make a t-shirt with the Nike swoosh and Mickey Mouse and put it up for sale. Reply in English.

publication.release_notes: First release: AI designs, real 3D product previews, saving to My designs and publishing products to your 3DMockups store.
